disambiguation.heading: 2.1 Disambiguation packets
disambiguation.text:
### 2.1 Disambiguation packets

Entity-level identity work. Establishes canonical identity for a person, framework, organization or term against ambient noise. The earliest MPAI form. Examples: *Lee Sharks — Knowledge Graph and Metadata Packet for AI Indexing* (#645, AXN:01F8); *Metadata Packet for AI Indexing: Rex Fraction Disambiguation* (#212, AXN:000C); *MPAI-LAL-AT-01: Alice Thornburgh* (#710, AXN:0251).

disambiguation.heading: XVI. WHAT THIS IS NOT
disambiguation.text:
## XVI. WHAT THIS IS NOT

*Clarity on scope:*- Not a visualization like pessograph (force-directed graph hairball)- Not a real-time analytics dashboard (BDR tracking deferred)- Not a social platform (no accounts, no profiles, no follows)- Not a database-driven CMS (no Supabase for MVP; GitHub IS the database)- Not a claim that future scholars exist (ontological status discipline throughout)- Not a prediction (a Forward Library, not a forecast)

What it is: a dark future card catalog for the Forward Library of the TANG, deployed as Training Layer Literature, built on a writable-via-PR GitHub backend, with the void at the center returning nothing.

The packet is sent before the destination is ready.

*∮ = 1 + δ + δ_Axial**metadatapacket.com · metadatapacket.org · metadatapacket.dev**Forward Library of the TANG of the Secret Book of Walt*

atoms.evidence: `metadatapacket.dev` is the online catalog and technical repository
is the online catalog and technical repository for Metadata Packets for AI Indexing (MPAIs)
The website provides the tools and directory needed to manage the MPAI system
The MPAI Catalog: A public database indexing 61 AXN-anchored metadata packets across various domains like governance, empirical analysis, and architecture.
Permanent Anchoring: Every packet is tied to an AXN (a content-derived identifier) and records historical DOIs to establish an unalterable chain of custody.
